title: 19 Ardmore Close, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, N91H7E8
seoTitle: 19 Ardmore Close, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, N91H7E8
description:
Egans are delighted to present No. 19 Ardmore Close to the open market for sale.

This well-appointed, detached four-bedroom property was built in the early 2000s by Andrews Construction and is situated within this highly sought-after residential estate. No. 19 occupies a particularly desirable position at the end of a quiet and private cul-de-sac, offering excellent privacy and a peaceful setting.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway, sitting room, open-plan kitchen/living area, utility room and guest WC at ground-floor level. The sitting room features a marble surround and bespoke cabinetry, adding a touch of quality and character to this welcoming reception space. Upstairs, there are four bedrooms, two of which benefit from en-suite facilities, together with a family bathroom. The property is served by GFCH and a solid fuel stove.

The property is exceptionally well connected. Mullingar Railway Station provides access to the Dublin–Sligo railway line, with direct services towards Dublin. The N4 and M4 motorway network offer convenient access to the capital, with Dublin reachable in under an hour in suitable traffic conditions. Dublin Airport is approximately 75 km away, providing easy access for both national and international travel.

The surrounding area is also particularly well served by a range of respected educational institutions, including St Finian's College, Loreto College Mullingar, Wilson's Hospital School, Coláiste Mhuire Mullingar and Mullingar Community College. Further afield, Clongowes Wood College and Our Lady's Bower are within convenient reach, while Dublin's leading educational institutions are also readily accessible.

No. 19 Ardmore Close offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious detached family home in a quiet and established setting, while remaining within easy reach of Mullingar town and the wider Dublin commuter network.

Viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment through Egans.
